name: Parser
caption: Parser

configuration.description: Selector language for all lines of the step. Exact, case-sensitive text. Missing or any other value is treated as JsonPath.
Text to parse, typically {{<httpSlug>_responseBody}}. SmartText, resolved before the step runs. Parsed once per run as JSON (JsonPath) or XML (XPath); used verbatim for RegEx.

Output definitions as { "<outputName>": "<selector>" }. Each key becomes a value output of the step; output names are truncated to 30 characters, selectors to 2048. Selector syntax depends on 'type': a JsonPath (e.g. "$.data.id"), an XPath (e.g. "//Order/@id"), or a .NET regular expression. The editor treats selectors as SmartText.

XPath only. Namespace overrides as { "<prefix>": "<uri>" } (prefix max 20, uri max 250 characters). When non-empty, ONLY these prefixes are registered (auto-discovery is skipped). When empty, namespaces are auto-discovered from the document (default namespace gets prefix 'def'; colliding prefixes get a numeric suffix such as 'ns2').

XPath only. { "<outputName>": true } marks lines whose matched elements are returned as outer XML instead of their inner text. Keys must equal keys of 'lines'. Ignored for attributes/text/CDATA nodes.
Designer-only sample input used by the editor's Run Preview. Not used at run time.

outputs.name: <each key of lines>
outputs.when: one declared output per key in configuration.lines

rules.check: configuration.type should be exactly "JsonPath", "XPath" or "RegEx"; anything else silently falls back to JsonPath.
configuration.lines must be a JSON object mapping output name to selector string (not an array of rows).
configuration.lines should contain at least one entry; without lines the step produces no outputs.
configuration.namespaces, if present, must be an object; any other type is ignored (treated as empty).
configuration.rawXmlLines, if present, must be an object of booleans; any other type is ignored.

Each key of 'lines' should be at most 30 characters (longer names are truncated). Keep names at most ~26 characters when the selector can return many items, because indexed runtime names (<name>[n]) are also cut at 30 characters.
type = JsonPath and input is not valid JSON (an empty input also fails).
type = XPath and input is not well-formed XML (an empty input also fails).
A syntactically invalid XPath or regular expression (and a JsonPath the platform rejects, e.g. one that matches several tokens) raises the platform's error and fails the step.

notes: Runtime output naming per line <name>: a single result is written as <name>; an array/multi result is written as <name>[0], <name>[1], ... (and NOT as <name>); no match writes <name> = ''. Downstream: {{<slug>_<name>}} gives the scalar or, for an indexed result, the first element; {{<slug>_<name>[n]}} addresses element n; a For Each or aggregate over {{<slug>_<name>}} walks all elements.

JsonPath: the selected token yields <name>. A selected JSON array yields <name>[i] per element (objects/arrays serialised as JSON text, null as ''). Strings are returned unescaped; numbers/booleans as text; a selected object as JSON text.

XPath: results are ALWAYS indexed (<name>[0] even for a single node). Elements give their inner text (outer XML when flagged in rawXmlLines), attributes their value, text/CDATA nodes their value. Unprefixed element names in the selector are rewritten to *[local-name()='Name'], so namespaced documents match without prefixes; prefixed names, '@attr', '*', '.', function steps like text() are left as written.

RegEx: every non-empty match produces one indexed output <name>[i]; if the pattern has a capture group, the first group's value is used, otherwise the whole match. Zero-width matches are skipped; if nothing remains, <name> = ''.
The editor's live preview and 'previewSample' do not affect run time. No editor validity check and no publish-time step check exist for this step; only the generic dangling-reference warning applies.
